messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your healthcare provider about any mental problems you or your child have, or about a family history of suicide, bipolar illness, or depression.
Call your healthcare provider right away if you or your child have any new or worsening mental symptoms during treatment.
This is especially important if you experience hearing voices.
It is also important if you see or believe things that are not real.
It is also important if you have new manic symptoms.
Circulation problems:
You may have blood circulation problems that can cause numbness, pain, or discoloration in your fingers or toes.
Call your doctor right away if you have unexplained wounds appearing on your fingers or toes during treatment.
Other warnings:
Do not use Adderall if you have used an MAO inhibitor in the past 14 days.
Examples of MAO inhibitors include isocarboxazid, linezolid, phenelzine, rasagiline, selegiline, and tranylcypromine.
Do not use Adderall if you have received a methylene blue injection.
A dangerous drug interaction could occur.
You may not be able to use Adderall if you have glaucoma.
Triplet: ["Adderall", "has contraindication", "glaucoma"]

The relation 'has contraindication' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
B. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
C. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
D. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
